usage: soil_saturation_ratio = GWETROOT directly per SRS.md Section 10.1. Label as 'soil saturation proxy'.
coverage_note: NASA POWER hourly GWETROOT confirmed (live test call, HTTP 422) to start 2001-01-01. 47 of 73 Darjeeling/Kalimpong events predate this and have null soil_saturation_ratio -- a real API coverage limit, not a fetch failure.
resolution_note: NASA POWER native resolution ~50km (MERRA-2 grid). All points in this region share one grid cell -- fetched once, replicated across named points.
